description: This file contains unit tests for the SubscriptionMarker class, including tests for implicit and explicit subscription marking functionality within the Orleans streaming runtime.

classes.name: SubscriptionMarkerTests
classes.description: Unit tests for SubscriptionMarker subscription marking functionalities, including implicit and explicit subscription ID handling.

methods.name: MarkAsImplicitSubscriptionTest
methods.description: Tests that a Guid is correctly identified as an implicit subscription and correctly marked as implicit.

methods.name: MarkAsExplicitSubscriptionTest
methods.description: Tests that a Guid is correctly marked as explicit and identified as not implicit after marking.
